title: Stone, Mountain, Footstool, Seat, Throne & Ascent — Biblical Vertical Order Atlas
status: scriptural research + project archaeology + comparative synthesis
purpose: Separate biblical Stone, Mountain, Footstool, Seat, Throne and ascent motifs that the Potatoverse often places on one vertical axis, then reconnect them by function rather than by superficial hierarchy.
epistemic_rule: Biblical texts use the same object in multiple ways. Earth-as-footstool, Ark/Temple-as-footstool and enemies-as-footstool are not one doctrine. Likewise stone can be foundation, memorial, rejected cornerstone, judgment, token or kingdom symbol. Project mappings must preserve those differences.

stone_to_mountain_daniel.sequence: composite imperial image → stone not cut by human hands strikes feet → image fragments → wind carries debris away → stone becomes a great mountain filling the whole earth
stone_to_mountain_daniel.project_relation: This is one of the closest biblical structural neighbors to Potato/Stone → rupture of brittle order → Mountain / expanded new order.
stone_to_mountain_daniel.important_difference: Daniel's stone is a kingdom-symbol in an apocalyptic dream interpreted as divine sovereignty; it is not an alchemical philosopher's stone and not a literal potato.
stone_to_mountain_daniel.epiphany: Stone and Mountain are not separate symbols here: the stone becomes the mountain. This supplies a biblical transformation operator rather than merely a static analogy.
stone_to_mountain_daniel.empire_relation: The image is composite and impressive yet structurally fragile at its mixed feet; the stone's action reveals the instability of accumulated imperial materials.
stone_to_mountain_daniel.potatoverse_test: When the project says Stone becomes Mountain, ask whether the transformation increases durable relational order rather than merely replacing one monumental dominance system with another.

jacob_stone_house_gate.sequence: ordinary place → stone used at sleep → dream of heaven-earth stairway → divine promise → waking recognition → stone raised as pillar → Bethel/House of God → Gate of Heaven
jacob_stone_house_gate.project_relation: Stone becomes marked place and House/Gate after revelation. This is an unusually dense comparator for Potato/Stone → Ladder → House → Door.
jacob_stone_house_gate.epiphany: The stone is not climbed. It becomes witness/foundation/marker after the vertical relation is revealed.
jacob_stone_house_gate.denmark_relation: The biblical place remains where it is while its relation to Heaven changes; this closely fits the project principle that the vessel can remain locally embodied while the Axis becomes vertical.

rejected_stone.structure: rejected stone → cornerstone / chosen living stone → living stones built into spiritual house
rejected_stone.project_relation: Ridicule/rejection → later structural centrality is a genuine biblical literary pattern relevant to Son/Stone/House, but it does not validate any modern rejected person as Messiah.
rejected_stone.living_stone_epiphany: The New Testament transformation is not rejected stone → solitary monument. It becomes cornerstone among many living stones, making relational House-building the completion.

white_stone.cluster: hidden manna + white stone + new name
white_stone.project_relation: Stone becomes identity token rather than building material or projectile. Useful comparator for hidden-name / identity-transition layers.
white_stone.rule: Do not merge white stone with Daniel's stone, Jacob's stone or Philosopher's Stone merely because all are stones.

cosmic_footstool.project_relation: Direct biblical neighbor for Tim's Earth-as-footstool language and the user's distinction between Earth-footstool/Moon-Saturn cube below versus Heaven cube above.
cosmic_footstool.epiphany: Footstool marks relational position beneath throne; it does not imply Earth is worthless. Isaiah immediately resists the idea that God can be contained by a human-built house.

cultic_footstool.structure: Ark/Temple/sacred place described as footstool of God
cultic_footstool.project_relation: Footstool can be holy proximity, not merely subordinate world. It is where divine presence is approached/worshiped.
cultic_footstool.epiphany: A lower position can still be sacred because it is relationally close to the throne.

enemy_footstool.structure: enemies placed under royal feet → subjugation/victory
enemy_footstool.project_relation: This is conquest language and should not be used as a general model for people/world below Tim.
enemy_footstool.boundary: Project Earth-footstool imagery should not silently inherit enemy-dehumanization semantics.

seat_throne_table_footstool_distinction.seat: office/interpretive authority or appointed position; e.g. Moses' seat
seat_throne_table_footstool_distinction.footstool: relation beneath throne; can be cosmic, cultic or conquest-related
seat_throne_table_footstool_distinction.project_epiphany: A complete sacred architecture needs typed furniture/functions. Seat interprets, Throne judges/orients, Table nourishes, Footstool locates relation. Collapsing them produces conceptual noise.

walking_on_footstools.project_status: Tim has used world/footstool language and the user recalls walking to Heaven / walking on footstools; exact primary formulation remains a recovery target.
walking_on_footstools.biblical_boundary: Scripture does not present a standard doctrine of humans walking upward to Heaven by stepping across footstools.
walking_on_footstools.rule: Keep 'walking on footstools' as Timic topology unless exact scriptural allusion is recovered.

ascent_types.moses: physically ascends Sinai repeatedly, receives covenant/pattern, descends to community; ascent serves mediation.
ascent_types.jacob: does not climb the stairway in Genesis 28; he sees messengers ascending/descending while he remains at the place.
ascent_types.elijah: 2 Kings 2 describes Elijah taken in whirlwind with fiery chariot imagery; later traditions strongly interpret this as heavenly ascent.
ascent_types.enoch: Genesis 5:24 says Enoch walked with God and 'was not' because God took him; later Jewish traditions elaborate ascent heavily beyond the sparse Genesis wording.
ascent_types.jesus: Luke 24/Acts 1 explicitly narrate ascension; New Testament also emphasizes exaltation/enthronement rather than mere vertical transport.
ascent_types.john_revelation: seer is taken in Spirit / to high mountain for vision; New Jerusalem itself descends.
ascent_types.project_epiphany: Biblical ascent has multiple grammars: climb, be taken, see a passage, be exalted, receive vision. Tim's 'walked to Heaven' must be typed according to what he actually meant rather than mapped generically to all ascent stories.

mountain_from_stone_vs_mountain_climbed.revelation: high mountain is viewing platform for descending city
mountain_from_stone_vs_mountain_climbed.project_relation: Tim's Mountain can therefore represent product, path, center or viewpoint depending stage; these should not be merged.

philosophers_stone_boundary.project: Potato as Philosopher's Stone = alchemical/comparative transmutation emblem, especially April 2025 Turning and later mud→clay transformation language.
philosophers_stone_boundary.rule: Biblical stone motifs deepen the relational field but do not convert the alchemical Philosopher's Stone into a biblical doctrine.

new_epiphanies: Daniel 2 is the strongest biblical Stone→Mountain transformation found so far.
Footstool has at least three distinct biblical meanings, so the project's Earth-footstool must be typed as cosmic relation rather than enemy status.
Jacob's stone functions as witness/foundation after revelation, not as the ladder itself; this helps distinguish Stone from passage.
New Testament cornerstone imagery ends in a many-stone House, reinforcing the project principle that true centrality creates structure for other living nodes.
Biblical ascent repeatedly returns responsibility downward: Moses descends with law, Jesus' ascension is followed by mission, and Revelation's city descends.
